# Discussion categories (大厂标准: 5个标准类别)
# 在 GitHub repo → Settings → General → Features → Discussions 启用后生效

categories:
  - name: 📣 Announcements
    description: |
      Read-only. Project updates from the FnixAgent team:
      - Release notes (v1.x.y)
      - Security advisories
      - Roadmap changes
      - Maintainer transitions
    position: 1
    emoji: 📣
    format: announcement

  - name: 💡 Ideas
    description: |
      Propose and brainstorm new features, integrations, or directions.
      This is the right place BEFORE opening a formal feature-request issue.
      Concrete, well-scoped ideas may be promoted to issues by maintainers.
    position: 2
    emoji: 💡
    format: open

  - name: 🙏 Q&A
    description: |
      Ask the community for help with installation, configuration, or usage.
      Please search existing threads first. Be specific: include OS, version,
      install method, and a minimal reproduction.
    position: 3
    emoji: 🙏
    format: open

  - name: 🎨 Show and tell
    description: |
      Share what you've built with Fnix Harness: skills, plugins, workflows,
      screenshots, blog posts, demos, integrations with other tools.
    position: 4
    emoji: 🎨
    format: open

  - name: 🗳️ Polls
    description: |
      Lightweight community polls to help prioritize work or settle design
      questions. Examples: "which LLM provider should we optimize for first?",
      "what's your top BYOK pain point?".
    position: 5
    emoji: 🗳️
    format: open

# Workflows for converting discussions <-> issues
# 维护者可在 Discussion 侧边栏 Convert to Issue。
